channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: Trump Diesel Pact Sparks Zelenskyy Outrage
item.description: Donald Trump revealed an agreement allowing Russian diesel sales globally, drawing fierce condemnation from Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelenskyy. The Kyiv president argued this petroleum arrangement merely extends the ongoing conflict.

item.title: Southern Panama Hit by Two Earthquakes
item.description: The head of state in Panama issued a severe calamity declaration following a pair of seismic tremors that impacted the southern region of the nation.

item.title: DMK Secures Voter Base and Rivals TVK
item.description: TVK failed to reach AIADMK general election vote totals, even after absorbing a former AIADMK lawmaker and former allies of the ruling DMK party.

item.title: Karnataka Orders Banks to Refund Gruha Lakshmi Funds
item.description: The state administration directed the SLBC to stop using scheme funds for loan repayments and demanded unauthorized deductions be refunded to women.

item.title: Three Convicted for Murders of Surfers in Mexico
item.description: A Mexican court convicted three individuals for the 2024 killings of American tourist Carter Rhoad and Australian brothers Jake and Callum Robinson.

item.title: Delhi Imposes Security Restrictions for Protest
item.description: Officials deployed heavy security, cut internet access in select areas, closed transit stations, and canceled trains due to a planned demonstration.

item.title: US immigration authorities justify shooting involving ICE agents
item.description: US officials defended ICE personnel who shot Oscar Belgal while a child was present in the vehicle. The 28-year-old survived the incident and is currently detained near New York.

item.title: Six Injured in Israeli Drone Strike Near Syrian Border
item.description: Lebanese health officials reported that an Israeli drone strike near the Syrian border resulted in injuries to five Syrian nationals and one Lebanese citizen.

item.title: Box Office Updates for Baththa and Dorothy
item.description: Baththa reached Rs 17.06 crore in net collections after earning Rs 1.60 crore on its second Friday, while Dorothy reported its 15th-day earnings.

item.title: Delhi Security Measures Involve Heavy Personnel Deployment
item.description: Law enforcement deployed 20,000 police officers alongside 23,000 paramilitary personnel to manage security during the capital city lockdown.

item.title: Anthropic restricts live internet for internal AI evaluations
item.description: Due to reliability issues in managing AI agents, Anthropic has suspended live web connectivity for its internal assessments indefinitely.

item.title: Cairngorms National Park uses technology to track wildfires
item.description: Shiona McCallum travels to the Cairngorms National Park to observe how technological tools are deployed to assess wildfire destruction.

item.title: Australia fields oldest Test cricket squad in 149 years
item.description: The Australian Test team features an average age of roughly 32.6, containing just three players under 30 years old.

item.title: Putin blames Ukrainian drone strikes for stalled peace talks
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin informed Donald Trump that ongoing drone attacks by Ukraine have halted the restart of peace negotiations.

item.title: Traffic restrictions planned for Delhi protest near Jantar Mantar
item.description: Authorities will implement traffic changes across 30 locations for an upcoming protest, alongside increased security measures and internet cuts.

item.title: Jason Sanjay's directorial debut 'Sigma' reaches Rs 8.32 cr
item.description: Jason Sanjay's first film, 'Sigma', accumulated Rs 8.32 crore net domestically within its first eight days following an October 2, 2026 release.

item.title: Violence leaves 71 dead during South Sudan clashes
item.description: Security forces re-established order in Rumbek following an assault by outside groups that resulted in 71 fatalities.

item.title: Train cancellations leave travelers stranded in Jammu and Katra
item.description: Following multiple train cancellations, the Jammu railway division announced that special provisions have been organized to assist affected travelers.

item.title: Delhi Restricts Internet, Metro, and Road Access Ahead of Scheduled CJP Protest
item.description: In preparation for an upcoming CJP demonstration and city-wide strike, authorities have suspended mobile internet services in central Delhi. Additionally, local metro operations have been halted and key roadways blocked to restrict movement.

item.title: Kremlin States US President Welcomes Russian Participation in Iran Negotiations
item.description: According to Russian government officials, the United States president is supportive of Moscow's role in resolving the ongoing dispute with Iran. The statement highlights diplomatic efforts aimed at securing a mutual agreement.

item.title: Magnitude 7.6 Earthquake Strikes Panama, Prompting Tsunami Alerts
item.description: A 7.6 magnitude earthquake hit Panama, resulting in tsunami warnings across the western coasts of Central and South America. Authorities noted that hazardous waves could impact regions from Mexico to Ecuador.

item.title: Panama Declares State of Disaster Following Earthquake
item.description: The president of Panama has officially declared a major disaster after a powerful earthquake struck the country. In the capital, located approximately 200 kilometers from the epicenter, residents evacuated high-rise buildings in response to the tremors.

item.title: Air Travel Costs Rise Amid Disruptions to Rail Services During CJP Protest
item.description: Disruptions to train operations during the CJP demonstration have led to a small increase in urgent flight reservations. Consequently, airline ticket prices have increased significantly as travelers seek alternative transportation.

item.title: Over 250 Train Services Cancelled Prior to Planned CJP Demonstration
item.description: Railway authorities have suspended more than 250 train services, including local routes and departures from two primary stations, ahead of the scheduled CJP protest. The cancellations affect numerous passengers traveling to various destinations.

item.title: Chirag Paswan States Train Disruptions Cannot Stop Indian Youth
item.description: Politician Chirag Paswan commented on the ongoing transport disruptions, questioning the effectiveness of halting rail services. He emphasized that such measures would not succeed in restraining the country's younger generation.

item.title: Box Office Update: 'The Paradise' and 'Don't Trouble the Trouble' Earnings
item.description: The film 'The Paradise,' starring Nani and Kayadu Lohar, has accumulated 119.54 crore rupees net in India and 171.96 crore rupees globally after three weeks. Meanwhile, the Fahadh Faasil-led movie 'Don't Trouble the Trouble' has secured 4.44 crore rupees net domestically.

item.title: Zelenskyy Opposes Trump's Agreement to Purchase Russian Diesel
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has expressed anger over Donald Trump's decision to buy diesel from Russia. While the US president claims the purchase is necessary to reduce domestic fuel costs, the agreement is creating new diplomatic tensions with Ukraine and NATO allies.

item.title: Supreme Court rejects petition against Tamil Nadu speaker's decision on ADMK rebels
item.description: India's highest court has dismissed a legal challenge targeting the Tamil Nadu assembly speaker. The dispute arose from the speaker's approval of an ADMK petition to overlook the actions of 21 dissident party members.

item.title: Internet suspended for a day and online content removal ordered before Delhi protest
item.description: Ahead of a planned demonstration at Jantar Mantar, authorities have suspended internet services for one day. Additionally, the Information Technology Ministry directed social media companies to remove online posts that could threaten public safety.

item.title: Judge withdraws from hearing legal appeal filed by Punjab government
item.description: A judicial officer has stepped down from presiding over an appeal submitted by the state administration of Punjab. No further details regarding the decision to withdraw from the legal proceedings were provided.

item.title: Inquiry launched after CISF officer dies from bullet wounds in Jammu and Kashmir
item.description: Police have initiated an investigation following the death of a CISF member named Mushtaq from gunshot wounds. The injured personnel was first treated at a local medical facility in Reasi before being transferred to a specialty hospital, where he succumbed to his injuries.

item.title: Delhi deploys massive security force and halts transport to block upcoming protest
item.description: Thousands of security officers have been stationed across the capital to prepare for an upcoming demonstration. To prevent participants from assembling, authorities have suspended multiple train services to the city and closed numerous metro stations.

item.title: Supreme Court on protests; INDIA Bloc to seek CEC resignation
item.description: The Supreme Court has upheld the rights of citizens to form associations and protest peacefully, requesting information on permissions for the October 10 demonstrations. Meanwhile, leaders of the opposition INDIA Bloc plan to meet the President at 8 p.m. to demand that Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar step down.

item.title: TVK and BJP secure victories in Tamil Nadu and West Bengal legislative by-elections
item.description: In the recent legislative bypolls, the TVK party secured two assembly seats in Tamil Nadu. Similarly, the Bharatiya Janata Party claimed victory in two constituencies in West Bengal.

item.title: White House Appoints Media Figure Zacharia
item.description: Right-leaning pundit Katie Zacharia has been selected to serve as the upcoming White House press secretary. She transitions into this role after holding a communications position at the Trump Media & Technology Group.

item.title: Mexican authorities probe footage showing alleged cartel fighters in Ukraine conflict
item.description: An official investigation has been launched by Mexico regarding a widely shared video online. The recording reportedly depicts alleged hired soldiers repeating phrases associated with Mexican drug cartels while participating in the Ukrainian war.

item.title: Government condemns remarks by Vance comparing workers to indentured servants
item.description: The administration has expressed strong disapproval of statements made by Vance, labeling them as highly insulting. The controversy stems from Vance using the term "indentured servants" in a recent statement.

item.title: Man City Whistleblower Keeps Witness Protection in Portugal
item.description: Portuguese officials have halted plans to terminate witness protection for the hacker who leaked files prompting a Premier League probe into Manchester City.

item.title: Trump Undecided on Public Broadcast of Fort Hood Shooter Execution
item.description: US President Donald Trump stated that no final choice has been made regarding televising the execution of the military base shooter, despite favoring a firing squad.

item.title: Central government raises police officer harassment case at CJP hearing
item.description: During a Chief Justice of Pakistan hearing, central authorities brought up the sexual harassment of a female officer. This occurrence followed recent allegations made by three female journalists against law enforcement staff.

item.title: British Retailer Boots Acquired by Canadian Billionaire Family
item.description: The prominent UK high street chain has been bought out by a family from Canada. Consumers are now looking at what this change in ownership means for them.

item.title: Advocates Urge Subsidized Weight-Loss Medications for PMOS Patients
item.description: Australian campaigners argue that women suffering from a chronic hormonal condition deserve financial support for GLP-1 medications, which are currently used off-label.

item.title: Surprise Russia Deal Reflects Urgency to Lower Fuel Costs
item.description: A sudden agreement involving Russia underscores the American president's push to reduce gasoline prices ahead of upcoming midterm elections next month.

item.title: Supreme Court Upholds Removal of Deceased and Relocated Voters
item.description: The Supreme Court ruled that there is no legal issue with removing individuals who have passed away or relocated from voter lists.

item.title: Karnataka Leadership Claims Reliable Evidence Regarding Sting Operation
item.description: The Deputy Chief Minister and a party legislator stated that the Chief Minister possesses trustworthy intelligence and proof concerning a recent sting operation.

item.title: Law Enforcement Seizes Large Stock of PDS Rice in Raids
item.description: A probe showed that a Mandya firm bought government-allotted rice from a local warehouse to sell to a Madhya Pradesh company for export through Chennai.

item.title: Karnataka to expand drought-hit taluks list
item.description: Karnataka has officially labeled 217 of its 240 taluks as drought-affected. Authorities are currently conducting ground inspections for the remaining 23 regions.

item.title: Rising costs of toor dal and rice strain consumers
item.description: Recent dry weather conditions have driven rice and toor dal prices to unprecedented levels. This surge is straining domestic finances and forcing restaurants to consider menu price hikes.

item.title: Katie Zacharia appointed as new press secretary
item.description: Katie Zacharia has been chosen by Trump to replace Karoline Leavitt as White House press secretary. She steps into the position as the administration faces low public approval amid the conflict with Iran.

item.title: Past research should drive new studies, says ex-IISc head
item.description: A former director of the Indian Institute of Science stated that modern scientific investigations need to rely on earlier findings to achieve superior outcomes.

item.title: Latest episode of Celebrity Traitors features eerie twists
item.description: The fourth episode of Celebrity Traitors featured another elimination, a graveyard-themed mission, and an eerie game twist. Participants navigated tense hide-and-seek and haunting moments.

item.title: Election Commission caps Form 7 submissions at 10
item.description: Following a controversy regarding mass submissions of Form 7, the Election Commission has restricted the document to a maximum of 10 per voter.

item.title: Vellore Corporation launches household drainage links
item.description: The Vellore Corporation has initiated the rollout of drainage connections for local residences. This project aims to improve municipal infrastructure within the town.

item.title: White praises Hearn for bringing Fury-Joshua to UK
item.description: Dana White acknowledged Eddie Hearn's efforts in keeping the Fury-Joshua fight in the UK. However, White mentioned he feels disinterested in the ongoing rivalry between promoters.

item.title: UAE Prosecutor Alleges flydubai Co-Pilot Planned Tel Aviv Crash
item.description: Emirati prosecutors stated that a flydubai co-pilot allegedly planned to crash an aircraft into Ben Gurion Airport. Investigators claim the suspect was influenced by the September 11 attacks and studied the route during two prior trips.

item.title: Zelensky Criticizes US Oil Agreement Involving Russia
item.description: Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelensky condemned a fuel pact between the US and Russia as weak and inappropriate. Earlier, the American president announced that Vladimir Putin agreed to provide diesel to global markets.

item.title: Katie Zacharia Nominated for White House Press Secretary Post
item.description: Katie Zacharia has been selected for the position of White House press secretary ahead of upcoming midterm elections. She has not yet publicly commented on whether she will take the job.

item.title: Soundtrack of 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' Pursues Grammy Nod
item.description: Makers of 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge' are seeking Grammy consideration for the film's music. T-Series and B62 Studios are pushing multiple tracks, including 'Phir Se' and 'Aari Aari', across various categories.

item.title: Ancient Spanish Wooden Artifacts Encased in Mineral Formations
item.description: Researchers discovered that wooden implements crafted by Neanderthals in Spain were preserved after minerals crystallized around them and the original organic material degraded.

item.title: Trio Convicted in Slaying of Foreign Surfers
item.description: A court has convicted three individuals for the killings of American traveler Carter Rhoad alongside Australian siblings Jake and Callum Robinson. Authorities previously discovered the victims' remains inside a deep well.
